tools.name: triage_ai_opportunity
tools.description: Score one proposed AI workflow across bottleneck severity, value capture, integration readiness, and risk posture. Returns a deterministic go-deeper or hold recommendation and a handoff-ready Markdown artifact. Read-only; not for organization-wide readiness reviews or production rollout planning.

decisionContext.description: The concrete decision this triage will inform.

requestedBy.description: Optional person or team requesting the triage.

score.description: Score from 1 (weak) to 5 (strong), grounded in the supplied evidence.

evidence.description: One or two concise sentences supporting this score.

evidenceLabel.description: Optional classification of the supplied evidence.

evidenceLabel.description: Optional classification of the supplied evidence.

confidence.description: Optional confidence override. The rubric supplies a conservative default.

followUps.description: Up to five questions ranked by how much their answers could change the decision.

canAnswerTopFollowUpInOneBusinessDay.description: Needed only when the total is 10-13: whether the highest-impact follow-up can plausibly be answered within one business day.

tools.name: assess_ai_readiness
tools.description: Assess an organization's readiness to run AI in production across five dimensions (data readiness, workflow ownership, governance and controls, delivery capacity, executive sponsorship), each scored 1-5 with evidence or marked unknown, plus classified candidate use cases. Returns a deterministic verdict — Ready, Ready with conditions, Not yet ready, or Insufficient evidence (thresholds: ready needs no dimension below 3; 2+ dimensions at 2 or below is not yet ready) — with a handoff-ready Markdown assessment. Read-only; not for triaging a single AI idea (use triage_ai_opportunity).

organizationName.description: The organization or team being assessed.

preparedFor.description: Optional sponsor or requester the assessment is prepared for.

score.description: Score from 1 (absent) to 5 (strong), or 'unknown' when the evidence to score this dimension is missing. Unknown is never treated as a low score.

evidence.description: One or two sentences supporting the score — or, for unknown, what evidence is missing.

evidenceLabel.description: Optional classification of the supplied evidence.

gap.description: Optional named gap for this dimension, used in the risk register and conditions.

dataReadiness.description: Data readiness: the data the workflows need exists, is accessible, and its quality problems are known and bounded.
